events.text: Make the meteor look and sound like one, NHL Hitz style, and call it METEOR everywhere, not cannon or shotgun. When I light it with F my stick blade burns with flame and sparks; while I hold shoot a ring of fire grows round me and pulses when full, with WINDING UP and the percent in the hint. On release: a white-hot flash, a boom, a camera kick and METEOR! over me; the puck becomes a fireball with a long fire trail, sparks and smoke. Every skater it floors gets a burst of fire, a clang and FLOORED! over him. A meteor goal makes the net bulge back a full metre and the glass shake hard enough to see, with fire and confetti in the mouth. Show METEOR BACK IN and the seconds. No meteor off a faceoff: F lights only a second after the drop.

[foreman] the rest of your change, which harbour did not make ("NOT DONE: "F lights only a second after the drop". This is a rule, not drawing. I found no key for it in CARTRIDGE.md (searched: ability, faceoff, drop, cooldown). The pack's F input goes through `scripts/human_input.gd`, which is outside my scope: it would have to stop sending `bAbility` for 60 frames after `Phase` turns from 3 to 0."): harbour said the cartridge has no key for part of it, but the catalog (ref/cores/rink/CARTRIDGE.md) has keys that may be exactly that: game.contact.check_cooldown_frames (integer 0..120 A check press has a cooldown (R-0060 point 4): for this many frames after a check press that opened a win); game.contact.check_cooldown_restart (boolean A mashed button lands nothing: true = a check press inside the cooldown (check_cooldown_frames) starts the coold); game.contact.take_shield_human_side (boolean true = the take shield (take_shield_frames) only for skaters of a side that has a human on it; a bot of the othe); game.contact.cross_back_human (boolean The human's cross-check takes a carrier's back (lane A215, track F1, the night; the Director's ruling of 15 Nov); game.skater.burst.frames (integer 0..60 How long the burst lasts after a stop or a cut, in physics frames; 0 turns the burst off.); game.stick.stop_grace_frames (integer 0..120 Lane A163 (track F2 evolution 6): the stop tucks the puck. On the frame the reverse brake of a carrier a): read those rows before you say a key is missing.
